newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks surge up again, sentiment improves.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks surge up again, sentiment improves.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed strongly higher in heavy volume on Thursday, eyeing gains on other European bourses and with outperformances in key blue chips Telefonica and Repsol.
Sentiment improved, with dealers more confident of gains medium term, especially if U.S. payroll data on Friday is good.
General index up 7.16 points, 1.54 percent, to 473.37 and the Ibex rose 83.62 points, 1.57 percent, to 5,402.70.
Telefonica added 85 pesetas to 3,420 in heavy volume after a large put-through. Repsol climbed 160 pesetas to 5,740.
"The bourse has followed the pace set by other markets and if tomorrow's employment data from the U.S. is good, we can start thinking about testing annual highs," said one trader.
Overall sentiment appeared to have improved, and although the rise was sudden, it was broad-based, providing some confidence after intraday erraticism seen recently, a dealer at a Spanish bank said.
